text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In IPF trials, one patient was inadvertently exposed to a dose of 600 mg daily for a total of 21 days. A non- serious adverse event (nasopharyngitis) occurred and resolved during the period of incorrect dosing, with no onset of other reported events. Overdosage was also reported in two patients in oncology studies who were exposed to a maximum of 600 mg twice daily for up to 8 days. Adverse events reported were consistent with the existing safety profile of nintedanib capsules. Both patients recovered. In case of overdosage, interrupt treatment and initiate general supportive measures as appropriate.
